'''Game News & Updates''' in ''[[The Duelist]]'' #21 (January 1998, page 87) names [[Cloud City Limited|Cloud City]], [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]], and the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="duelist21news" />

[[File:Duelist 21 page 87.jpg|thumb|right|260px|The Duelist #21, January 1998, page 87.]]

The SWCCG item continues the Game News & Updates column that begins on page 86.

<blockquote>
'''Star Wars CCG''' (Decipher, Norfolk, VA): At press time, ''Cloud City's'' ship date was November 4 (9-card boosters with one rare, $2.50). The first of three 165-card expansions based on ''Return of the Jedi'', ''Jabba's Palace'' (formerly ''Tatooine'') is planned for March. The World Championship, with over 50 players from 20 countries, takes place December 4 in Norfolk, VA.
</blockquote>
